page_title: VER 2-2 INT | Verona v Inter 26/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' That's the end of the match.
90+3' Celebrations are cut short for Inter as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
90+3' Wait! Referee Luca Zufferli has indicated he is going to review the Inter goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
90+2' GOAL! Alexis Sanchez (Inter) collects a pass and from inside the box he lifts the ball over Simone Perilli, who was off his line. What a finish that is! 2:3.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
90' Verona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
89' The percentage of ball possession is – 36:64.
87' Verona quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

84' Francesco Acerbi (Inter) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the middle of the target that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
83' Substitution. Tomas Suslov walks off the pitch and Alphadjo Cisse (Verona) comes on as a substitute.
80' Tomas Suslov (Verona) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

79' Tijjani Noslin (Verona) was close to scoring after a great solo effort and unleashed a promising shot from the edge of the penalty area. The ball went towards the bottom left corner, but Emil Audero showed his agility and saved this one.

77' Elayis Tavsan (Verona) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the bottom right corner. Emil Audero pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.

76' Tijjani Noslin (Verona) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity! The ball goes out of play and Inter will have a goal kick.
74' Marco Baroni has decided to substitute Reda Belahyane and he is replaced by Daniel Silva (Verona).
74' It is time for a substitution. Elayis Tavsan (Verona) is on for Stefan Mitrovic.
74' Tomas Suslov (Verona) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
73' The corner from Tomas Suslov (Verona) is intercepted by the defence.
71' Inter take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
71' Inter work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
68' Substitution. Emil Audero is replaced by Raffaele Di Gennaro (Inter).
68' Here is a change. Nicolo Barella is going off and Simone Inzaghi gives the last tactical orders to Kristjan Asllani (Inter).
67' Marco Baroni decides to make a substitution. Juan Cabal will be replaced by Giangiacomo Magnani (Verona).
67' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Darko Lazovic walks off the pitch to be replaced by Charlys (Verona).
64' Davide Frattesi (Inter) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Luca Zufferli blows for a foul.
64' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Stefan Mitrovic (Verona).
63' Stefan Mitrovic (Verona) meets a cross just outside the area and gets in a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
61' Luca Zufferli shows a yellow card to Nicolo Barella (Inter) for his blatant foul.
59' Darko Lazovic (Verona) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
56' The game has come to an end for Marko Arnautovic. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Alexis Sanchez (Inter).
56' Simone Inzaghi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Tajon Buchanan (Inter) replacing Federico Dimarco.
56' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Denzel Dumfries departs the field of play to be replaced by Juan Cuadrado (Inter).
55' Ruben Vinagre (Verona) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
51' Reda Belahyane (Verona) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball.
49' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Verona was in an offside position.
48' A pass from Nicolo Barella (Inter) is intercepted by Simone Perilli and the move breaks down.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Luca Zufferli to decide it wasn’t offside. The relieved Inter players can finally celebrate.
45+2' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Inter players aren’t happy.
45+1' 2 - 2 Goal! Davide Frattesi plays a short, square pass into the path of Marko Arnautovic (Inter), who bends a shot straight into the right side of the goal to make it 2:2. Fabulous goal!
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Luca Zufferli no option but to blow his whistle.
42' Verona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
41' Surely that's handball by one of the Inter players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
41' Ruben Vinagre (Verona) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
37' 2 - 1 Goal! Tijjani Noslin tees up Tomas Suslov (Verona) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the bottom right corner. 2:1.
36' It looks like Darko Lazovic (Verona) saw red with that tackle. Luca Zufferli won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
33' The ball possession at the moment is 32:68.
30' What was Juan Cabal (Verona) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
28' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Denzel Dumfries (Inter). The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
26' Ruben Vinagre (Verona) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
25' Inter seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
23' Tijjani Noslin (Verona) was too forceful with his tackle and Luca Zufferli interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
22' Stefan Mitrovic (Verona) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.
19' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play.

19' Marcus Thuram (Inter) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going into the roof of the net, but Simone Perilli has other ideas and makes a brilliant save. The ball goes out of play. Inter are awarded a corner kick.
17' 1 - 1 Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Tomas Suslov finds Tijjani Noslin (Verona) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball into the bottom right corner. 1:1.
14' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Simone Perilli is alert and denies him with a nice save.
13' Tomas Suslov (Verona) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
10' 0 - 1 Goal! Some very poor defending from the opponent allows Marko Arnautovic (Inter) the chance to get to the edge of the box and he makes no mistake with a lovely finish. It's 0:1.
7' Luca Zufferli couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Davide Frattesi (Inter) and blew his whistle.
3' The resulting set piece from Verona is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
3' Tijjani Noslin (Verona) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Now Verona have a corner.
3' The corner is swung in but Verona can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Inter will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Luca Zufferli.
